job.job_description:
Please find the JD below for the Web application development

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain web-based automation tools.
candidate should know Python very well, knows manageable HTML and Javascript, have automation mindset(must)
Develop and enhance automation solutions for Siemens Teamcenter and related PLM applications.
Analyze business requirements and convert them into scalable software solutions.
Develop reusable components and maintain high-quality, maintainable code.
Debug, troubleshoot, and optimize existing applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver automation projects.
Utilize AI-assisted development tools (e.g., VS Code AI extensions, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate development, debugging, documentation, and code reviews.
Participate in code reviews and follow software engineering best practices.

Required Skills

Experience in web application development.
Good knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular.
Experience developing backend services using Node.js, Java, or .NET.
Understanding of REST APIs and JSON.
Exposure to Siemens Teamcenter or other PLM systems.
Familiarity with version control.
Experience using AI-powered developer tools such as:
Visual Studio Code AI extensions
GitHub Copilot
ChatGPT or similar AI coding assistants
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
